body: Seeded randomness — a run's randomness from one seed; two runs of one seed read the same state (v030-13).

Capability `matrix#v030-13` (escher-0.3.0): requirement «A run's randomness comes from a seed, so two runs of one seed
read the same state»; observed gap «Randomness depends on the host.»; method `integration`; acceptance «Two runs given
one seed read the same state at every step.» Intent §Findings 9 (C2): «A run's randomness comes from a seed, and its
fonts are bundled, so two hosts read the same state the same way. These are the trust layer under E2's replays.»

- A seed for a run: a run of the driver (a held `Session`, and the harness it holds) is given one seed, and every
  source of randomness the run's app and page can read draws from it — so two runs given one seed read the same state
  at every step, and a kept check replays the run it recorded.

- The app-facing source: a Dioxus app hosted by the driver reads its randomness from the run's seed, through one
  engine-provided source, rather than from the host.
- The page-facing source: a page script's `Math.random` in a seeded run draws from the run's seed.

- The proof: an integration check, both layout modes, of two runs given one seed reading the same state (snapshot text
  and diffs) at every step of a scripted sequence on an app that reads randomness, and of two runs given different
  seeds reading a difference — so the check cannot pass vacuously.

- Not bundled fonts (v030-14, the next entry), not start-in-a-state (v030-08), not auto-exploration (v030-09) —
  auto-exploration and replay are this seed's later readers, not this chunk's work.

- No new listener, port, socket, env read or log field carrying a seed's value; a seed is not a secret, but it stays
  out of every log line by the content rule unless a ratified decision says otherwise.
- The windowed shell (`blitz-shell`) and the browser app are not seeded runs.

- `4f68f0d523ae` (the last wrap's flip, HEAD): green · checks 17/17 · wall 1391 s · CI#43539259481 completed/success.

body: * -text

_Generated by /andromeda-phase P4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not
edit during an /implement run._
- **Marker:** 2026-11-14-seeded-randomness · **Version:** escher-0.3.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-14T02:22:10Z

A run's randomness comes from one seed, so two runs given one seed read the same state at every step (`matrix#v030-13`,
intent §Findings 9, C2). Today no randomness source is offered to an app: a Dioxus app that wants a random number takes
it from the host. This chunk adds the one engine-provided source a Dioxus app reads — `dioxus_native_dom::SeededRandom`
through the hook `use_seeded_random` — and makes every harness-built Dioxus document read one run seed: a fixed
`DEFAULT_SEED` unless the builder of its `VirtualDom` provides another at the root. Every driver session (command line,
host, `mcp` and coverage roles, replay) boots through `Harness::from_vdom`, so every hosted run reads the default seed
and every kept check replays the run it recorded.

The shape follows the precedents the history files name: a run input reaching the app as a root context
(`stand_root`'s `TimerTicks`; the ungated `reached` record, `(architecture · decision/dioxus-root-contexts)`), and the
harness supplying determinism to every document it builds as it supplies the one `VirtualClock`
`(architecture · decision/one-virtual-clock)`. The module is ungated, like `reached` and `signal_registry`
`(architecture · decision/accessibility-feature-gating)`, so the wasm build compiles it. It is written by hand
(splitmix64), taking no dependency `(security-plan · decision/workspace-inherited-dependency-versions)`, and adds no
log site, span, field, print or env read `(obs-plan · decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content)`,
`(security-plan · decision/driver-reads-only-rust-log)`.

No seed crosses a driver carrier in this chunk: whether `start` takes a `seed` is the founder's fork F1
(`.andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T01-51-56-phase/founder-forks.md`), a Boundary widening (`rul-izni57qv`), and the plan is
built on its lean A — the run's seed is the boot's — on the operator's directive that the founder's forks are listed
with their lean and not waited on (`inputs#I1`). The page-facing `Math.random` is outside every driver run and outside
this chunk (scope, premise-corrected). The proof is a new stand check over a fixture app that reads the seeded source:
two runs of one seed equal at every step in both layout modes and in a second process, two seeds differing, and a kept
check replaying its seeded run.

1. **The seeded source** — create `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/seed.rs` (opens with `//!` naming what it is and that
   it holds no content and logs nothing; keeps arch S4). It holds:
   - `pub const DEFAULT_SEED: u64 = 0` — the seed a harness-built document reads when its builder gives none.
   - `pub struct SeededRandom` — `Clone`; every clone shares ONE generator state (an `Rc<Cell<u64>>`), so every
     component of a document draws from one stream in the order the draws happen. A hand `Debug` writes the type
     name alone, no state (obs S4).
   - `SeededRandom::from_seed(seed: u64) -> Self`; `next_u64(&self) -> u64` — splitmix64 (state advanced by
     `0x9E3779B97F4A7C15`, then the two xor-shift-multiply rounds `0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9`, `0x94D049BB133111EB`, all
     wrapping); `below(&self, bound: u64) -> u64` — a value in `0..bound` by the 128-bit multiply-high of `next_u64`
     and `bound`, `0` for a `bound` of `0` (no panic path, no division).
   - `pub fn use_seeded_random() -> SeededRandom` — a Dioxus hook: `use_hook` once per call site, returning the
     `SeededRandom` the nearest ancestor (the root) provides through dioxus-core's context lookup
     (`try_consume_context`), else a generator seeded from the host (a private `from_host` taking std's
     `RandomState` hasher output — std only), which is the windowed shell's case, not a run.
   - An inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`: splitmix64's published first three outputs for seed 0
     (`0xE220A8397B1DCDAF`, `0x6E789E6AA1B965F4`, `0x06C45D188009454F`) as a stated table with its row count asserted;
     two generators of one seed equal over 1,000 draws, two seeds differing at the first draw; a clone advancing the
     shared stream; `below` inside its bound over a stated table of bounds (`1`, `6`, `u64::MAX`) and `0` for bound
     `0`. Failures name a row index only (keeps tests S5).

2. **Export it, ungated** — in `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/lib.rs`, `mod seed;` beside `reached` and
   `signal_registry` with no `cfg(feature = "accessibility")`, and `pub use seed::{DEFAULT_SEED, SeededRandom,
   use_seeded_random};`.

3. **The harness's run seed** — in `packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs`, `Harness::from_vdom` reads, before
   `DioxusDocument::new`, whether the vdom's root scope already holds a `SeededRandom` context (dioxus-core's root
   context lookup inside `VirtualDom::in_runtime`); where it holds none, it provides
   `SeededRandom::from_seed(DEFAULT_SEED)` with `VirtualDom::provide_root_context`. A root context the builder provided
   (`VirtualDom::with_root_context(SeededRandom::from_seed(s))`) stands. `from_vdom`'s `///` states it;
   `from_component` reaches it through `from_vdom`; `wrap` provides nothing (a wrapped document keeps what its builder
   gave, as it keeps its clock). `HarnessOptions` is unchanged. The harness adds no `tracing`, no print and no env read
   `(security-plan · decision/test-harness-no-tracing-no-style)`.

4. **The proof** — create `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_seeded_randomness.rs`, opening with `//!` naming the
   behaviour (keeps arch S1, tests S1; its `stand_` prefix puts it in the stand-repeat rounds by the leg's glob, tests
   S7). Its fixture, stated in the file (one reader, tests S6): a component reading `use_seeded_random`, drawing three
   die values (`below(6) + 1`) at its first render and one more on each click of a keyed `button` `id="roll"`, each
   value a keyed list item whose text is the value; every actionable element keyed (layouts S1). Each run boots it with
   `Harness::from_vdom(…, seven_guis::stand::options(incremental))` — the stand's pinned viewport and bundled font,
   offline — held in a `Session::start`, and is driven through `Session::run` alone: a `snapshot`, then five `click`s
   on `roll`, each followed by a `snapshot`; a run's reading is its eleven answer lines in order. Every test runs both
   layout modes (keeps tests S2), takes no sleep and reads no wall clock (tests S3), prints nothing but the re-run
   child's digests (obs S1), and its failures name a mode and a step index, never an answer (tests S5). Tests:
   - `the_fixture_reads_the_seeded_source` — fixture-first: under seed 7 and seed 8 the boot snapshot texts differ
     (keeps arch S3).
   - `one_seed_two_runs_read_the_same_state_at_every_step` — two runs given seed 7: all eleven answer lines equal,
     step by step.
   - `two_seeds_read_different_states` — runs given seed 7 and seed 8: the boot answer line differs (the vacuity
     control of the test above).
   - `a_run_given_no_seed_reads_the_default_seed` — a run whose vdom carries no `SeededRandom` reads, step by step,
     the same eleven lines as a run given `SeededRandom::from_seed(DEFAULT_SEED)`.
   - `a_second_process_reads_the_same_state` — the re-execution pattern of `stand_id_persistence`: the test re-runs
     its own binary with a fixed argv naming one child test, which prints, one per line, `escher_driver::answer_digest`
     of each of a seed-7 run's eleven answer lines (digests only, no answer text); the parent reads them and asserts
     them equal to its own run's digests (both layout modes). Its child streams are read, not inherited (tests S4).
   - `a_kept_check_replays_its_seeded_run` (`cfg(unix)`, item by item, `(test-plan · decision/recording-checks-unix-gated)`)
     — a seed-7 session recording into an owner-only directory under `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` (the build-time path the
     session checks already read), its kept check read back with `Check::from_bytes`, then `Check::replay` on a fresh
     seed-7 session reads every step equal, and on a fresh seed-8 session stops at its first step; the directory is
     removed after.

5. **Lean A held** — no file under `packages/escher-driver/`, `examples/seven_guis/` or `tests/blitz-tests/checks/`
   changes, and `Cargo.lock` does not move (no dependency): no verb, argument kind, carrier, kept-check key, span field
   or exit is added `(architecture · decision/validated-verb-set-widened-by-ratification)`,
   `(security-plan · decision/closed-driver-verb-schema)`. The stand reads no randomness, so every served task and both
   committed Counter checks read as before under the default seed.

6. **Gates** — run the `[[gate]]` entries in order; `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` last before the operator
   pass. The red-before-green control of the new check is implement's one-shot run, never an entry: with step 3's
   provide removed and the fixture booted with no seed, `a_run_given_no_seed_reads_the_default_seed` reads red
   (`gate.py control`, the file `packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs` and the provide line it removes); with
   `below` returning a constant, `the_fixture_reads_the_seeded_source` reads red (the file
   `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/seed.rs`).
- `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/seed.rs` — `DEFAULT_SEED`, `SeededRandom`, `use_seeded_random`, its unit tests
- `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_seeded_randomness.rs` — the proof over a seeded fixture, both layout modes
- `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/lib.rs` — `mod seed;` ungated and its three re-exports
- `packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs` — `Harness::from_vdom` provides the default run seed where the vdom holds none

- `packages/blitz-test-harness/Cargo.toml` — named by research as a possible edit; the harness already declares `dioxus-core` and `dioxus-native-dom`, so implement leaves it unchanged unless the build names a missing dependency

The gates run on the dev host, Linux. Nothing boots outside the harness: there is no live leg, and the real boot is
/implement P3's. The base sha in the census entries is HEAD as this plan is written,
`4f68f0d523aed2d6c3ef7e34ddccf2ca05c0506c`.

The diff is OS-sensitive: the new check re-executes its own binary (a process) and gates its recording test on
`cfg(unix)`. So the plan carries the operator's hygiene, push and CI-read entries: CI's «Test (windows)» and «Test
(macos)» legs witness the re-executed child on each OS, and «Test (windows)» the unix-gated test's absence there.
The stand-repeat and coverage legs are not local entries: CI's «Stand checks repeated» (the new `stand_` file, three

body:
- (tests, `matrix#v030-13`) Two runs of a fixture app reading `use_seeded_random`, booted through `Harness::from_vdom`
  at the stand's options and held in a `Session`, given one seed (7), read the same answer line at every one of
  eleven steps (a `snapshot`, then five `click`s on `roll` each followed by a `snapshot`), in both layout modes and in
  a second process (digests compared); runs given seeds 7 and 8 read different boot screens; a run given no seed reads
  the same lines as one given `DEFAULT_SEED`; and a kept check recorded on seed 7 replays every step equal on a fresh
  seed-7 session and stops at its first step on a seed-8 session — `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --test
  stand_seeded_randomness` returns 0.

- (arch) `SeededRandom`, `use_seeded_random` and `DEFAULT_SEED` are exported by dioxus-native-dom without the
  `accessibility` feature, and `Harness::from_vdom` provides the default seed only where the vdom holds none
  (`(architecture · decision/accessibility-feature-gating)`, `(architecture · decision/one-virtual-clock)`) —
  `cargo test -p dioxus-native-dom --locked` and `cargo test -p blitz-test-harness --locked` return 0.

- (obs, security) The changed production code grows no log site, print, env read or panic path, and the witness takes
  no sleep or wall-clock read — the two census entries read `last line 0`
  (`(obs-plan · decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content)`, `(test-plan · decision/no-sleep-or-wall-clock-in-checks)`).

- (security) No seed crosses a carrier: no driver, stand or committed-check file and no lock line moves —
  `git diff --quiet 4f68f0d523aed2d6c3ef7e34ddccf2ca05c0506c -- packages/escher-driver examples/seven_guis
  tests/blitz-tests/checks Cargo.lock` returns 0 (`(security-plan · decision/closed-driver-verb-schema)`).

- (tests) The existing replay, recording, handler-coverage and second-process checks stay green under the workspace
  build, and `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` returns 0.
- (ci) The operator's CI read of the pre-CI commit reads `verdict: green`, its run id named in the report.

- Spec anchors: `(architecture · decision/dioxus-root-contexts)`, `(architecture · decision/accessibility-feature-gating)`,
  `(architecture · decision/one-virtual-clock)`, `(architecture · decision/session-library-depends-on-no-app)`,
  `(architecture · decision/validated-verb-set-widened-by-ratification)`, `(architecture · decision/headless-documents-sequential-style)`,
  `(security-plan · decision/closed-driver-verb-schema)`, `(security-plan · decision/boundary-widening-rule)`,
  `(security-plan · decision/test-harness-no-tracing-no-style)`, `(test-plan · decision/recording-checks-unix-gated)`,
  `(test-plan · decision/no-sleep-or-wall-clock-in-checks)`, `(test-plan · decision/stand-checks-in-both-layout-modes)`,
  `(obs-plan · decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content)`, `(layout-templates · decision/held-instance-reads-as-fresh-boot)`.

- History precedents: 2026-11-08-handler-coverage (the ungated root context), 2026-10-18-one-virtual-clock (the
  harness's determinism source), 2026-10-06-id-persistence and 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot (a second process),
  2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay (replay).

- Research files inspected: `packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs`, `examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs`,
  `examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs`, `packages/escher-driver/src/session.rs`, `packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs`,
  `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/lib.rs`, `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/reached.rs`, `packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs`.
- Inputs: `inputs#I1` — the operator's directive on the founder's forks.

- Leaned F1 A (no carrier crossing) per `founder-forks.md` on `inputs#I1`; leaned the windowed fallback to the host
  per the scope's boundary «The windowed shell (`blitz-shell`) and the browser app are not seeded runs»; leaned the
  fixture into the check's own file per `(test-plan · decision/shared-fixtures-in-one-module)` («a page with one
  reader … stays in its own check file»).

- A `seed` argument on `start`, `--seed` on the command line or a seed key in the kept check — the founder's F1,
  leaned A; not built here, whatever F1's outcome (B is a new route entry, not a revision).

- A `HarnessOptions` field for the seed — rejected: 33 literal sites (`git grep -n "HarnessOptions {"`) for no reader
  the root context does not already serve.
- Seeding page script (`Math.random` in blitz-vibey-script) — out of every driver run (research §Sweeps); not touched.
- A PRNG crate (`rand`, `fastrand`) — rejected: no dependency for a fixed small algorithm; the lock does not move.

- A per-call-site generator seeded from the run seed — rejected: two call sites would read one stream twice; one
  shared stream drawn in order is the run's.

- Changing a stand task to read randomness — rejected: the served tasks and committed checks stay as they read
  `(layout-templates · decision/session-roles-share-stand-boot)`.

- dioxus-core resolves to 0.7.10 in `Cargo.lock`; `VirtualDom::with_root_context`, `provide_root_context` and
  `in_runtime` stand at `dioxus-core-0.7.10/src/virtual_dom.rs:349-368`, `try_consume_context` and `has_context` at
  `global_context.rs:39-72` (research §Files inspected).

- A context provided after `VirtualDom::new` and before `DioxusDocument::new` reaches the first render: the root scope
  exists from `VirtualDom::new` and `initial_build` renders it (`harness.rs:112-121`).

- `from_vdom`'s callers: the four stand boots and some 30 blitz-tests targets (`calls WHERE callee_name =
  'from_vdom'`, trace `tree-query-2026-11-14-seeded-randomness.json`); none provides a `SeededRandom` today
  (`git grep -n SeededRandom` reads 0 at the base), so each now reads `DEFAULT_SEED` and reads nothing of it.

- A second process: `stand_id_persistence` re-executes its own test binary with a fixed argv and reads the child's
  stdout into the assertion only — the sanctioned print `(obs-plan · decision/checks-silent)`.

- Expected amendments (wrap): architecture §Standard Contracts — a contract for the seeded source
  (`SeededRandom`, `use_seeded_random`, `DEFAULT_SEED`, one shared stream, the host fallback outside a run) and the
  harness's default run seed beside `(architecture · contract/test-harness/virtual-clock)`; architecture §Cross-cutting
  Patterns — the run seed as a root context, ungated, beside `(architecture · decision/accessibility-feature-gating)`.

- Expected amendments (wrap): architecture §Standard Contracts — an absence: a seed on the driver's carriers, on F1's
  lean A (`founder-forks.md`), PROVISIONAL until the founder's word; Boundary widening pattern `rul-izni57qv`,
  answered by `delegate the operator`'s directive (`inputs#I1`) to proceed on the lean.

- Expected amendments (wrap): test-plan §5 Integration Test Strategy — the seeded-runs check, both layout modes, a
  second process and a replay, beside `(test-plan · decision/stand-checks-in-both-layout-modes)`.

- Expected amendments (wrap): obs-plan §3 Observability Harness Contract — the seed module and the harness's provide
  add no log site, span, field or env read, joining the silence census beside
  `(obs-plan · decision/driver-library-installs-no-subscriber)`.

body:
4. **The proof** — create `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_seeded_randomness.rs`, opening with `//!` naming the
   behaviour (keeps arch S1, tests S1; its `stand_` prefix puts it in the stand-repeat rounds by the leg's glob, tests
   S7). Its fixture, stated in the file (one reader, tests S6): a component reading `use_seeded_random`, drawing three
   die values (`below(6) + 1`) at its first render and one more on each click of a keyed `button` `id="roll"`, each
   value a keyed list item whose text is the value; every actionable element keyed (layouts S1). Each run boots it with
   `Harness::from_vdom(…, seven_guis::stand::options(incremental))` — the stand's pinned viewport and bundled font,
   offline — held in a `Session::start`, and is driven through `Session::run` alone: a `snapshot`, then five `click`s
   on `roll`, each followed by a `snapshot`; a run's reading is its eleven answer lines in order. Every test runs both
   layout modes (keeps tests S2), takes no sleep and reads no wall clock (tests S3), prints nothing but the re-run
   child's digests (obs S1), and its failures name a mode and a step index, never an answer (tests S5). Tests:
   - `the_fixture_reads_the_seeded_source` — fixture-first: under seed 7 and seed 8 the boot snapshot texts differ
     (keeps arch S3).
   - `one_seed_two_runs_read_the_same_state_at_every_step` — two runs given seed 7: all eleven answer lines equal,
     step by step.
   - `two_seeds_read_different_states` — runs given seed 7 and seed 8: the boot answer line differs (the vacuity
     control of the test above).
   - `a_run_given_no_seed_reads_the_default_seed` — a run whose vdom carries no `SeededRandom` reads, step by step,
     the same eleven lines as a run given `SeededRandom::from_seed(DEFAULT_SEED)`.
   - `a_second_process_reads_the_same_state` — the re-execution pattern of `stand_id_persistence`: the test re-runs
     its own binary (`std::env::current_exe()`) once with the fixed argv `--ignored --exact {the child} --nocapture`,
     setting or removing no env var, its output captured by `Command::output` (which reaps the child); the child, an
     `#[ignore]` test of the same file, prints, one per line, `escher_driver::answer_digest`
     of each of a seed-7 run's eleven answer lines (digests only, no answer text); the parent reads them and asserts
     them equal to its own run's digests (both layout modes). Its child streams are read, not inherited (tests S4).
   - `a_kept_check_replays_its_seeded_run` (`cfg(unix)`, item by item, `(test-plan · decision/recording-checks-unix-gated)`)
     — a seed-7 session recording into an owner-only directory under `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` (the build-time path the
     session checks already read), its kept check read back with `Check::from_bytes`, then `Check::replay` on a fresh
     seed-7 session reads every step equal, and on a fresh seed-8 session stops at its first step; the directory is
     removed after.
